question: What repo rate was declared by the Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) on 9th October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer i**s __'6.50%.'__**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) Decision:**

 
 
• In 2024,** the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) decided to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50%** under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) for the 9th consecutive time.
